# Static cURL 8.23.0 with HTTP3

## Components

- libcurl/8.23.0
- OpenSSL/4.0.3
- zlib/1.3.1.zlib-ng
- brotli/1.2.0
- zstd/1.5.7
- c-ares/1.34.8
- libidn2/2.3.8
- libpsl/0.23.3
- libssh2/1.11.1
- nghttp2/1.70.0
- ngtcp2/1.25.0
- nghttp3/1.18.0

## Protocols

dict file ftp ftps gopher gophers http https imap imaps ipfs ipns mqtt mqtts pop3 pop3s rtsp scp sftp smtp smtps telnet tftp ws wss

## Features

alt-svc asyn-rr AsynchDNS brotli CAcert ECH HSTS HTTP2 HTTP3 HTTPS-proxy HTTPSRR IDN IPv6 Largefile libz NTLM PSL SSL SSLS-EXPORT threadsafe UnixSockets zstd

## License

This binary includes various open-source software such as curl, openssl, zlib (or zlib-ng), brotli, zstd, libidn2, libssh2, nghttp2, ngtcp2, nghttp3. Their license information has been compiled and is included in the dev package.

## Build Info

Built by [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/stunnel/static-curl/actions/runs/38545003806)
